metadata.title: Foundational Sovereignty: Literacy for the Mesh
metadata.notes: Bridging K-12 concepts to the Praxis professional lifecycle.

nodes.title: Energy & Circuits: Foundational Physics
nodes.description: Moving beyond the lantern. Formal study of Ohm's Law, Joule heating, and circuit topology. Understanding how energy flows from the sun to the ledger.

nodes.title: The Cryptographic Mind
nodes.description: How to own your identity. The logic of asymmetric cryptography, hashing, and distributed ledgers. Understanding why keys are the foundation of modern freedom.

nodes.title: Collective Logic & Decision Making
nodes.description: Introduction to consensus. Quorums, vetoes, and the tragedy of the commons. How small groups reach high-trust decisions without a leader.

nodes.title: Cycles of the Living Substrate
nodes.description: The Carbon, Nitrogen, and Phosphorus cycles. Understanding soil as a biological battery and the role of mycelium in planetary homeostasis.

edges.rationale: Building a lantern provides the tactile intuition for formal circuit physics.
Solar PV technician track requires foundational circuit physics.
Understanding cryptography provides the 'why' behind the mesh handshake.
Soil microbiology requires understanding general biological cycles.
